_comment: Rumours and small talk from the people of the plaza (game/rumors.py; v0.47.0). User: in rarer cases, townsfolk pass on one of the Wayfinder's words as part of a rumour or chat. Ask someone listed in 'who' ("Heard anything lately?"): at most once a Pulse each, with chance 'chance' they pass on a word you don't know yet (any slot), in one of 'word_lines' ({word} is the word, shown in brackets); otherwise one of 'chatter'. ALL LINES ARE PLACEHOLDERS (they invent no lore).
word_lines: A Hunter in the plaza was saying a word to the Wayfinder I'd never heard before: {word}. Make of it what you like.
Overheard two of your lot arguing over a word. {word}, it was. Something about the Wayfinder.
Someone left a note by the well with one word on it: {word}. Mean anything to you?
chatter: Nothing worth the telling. Same as yesterday.
Quiet, mostly. Hunters in, Hunters out.
Only what everyone knows: the Wayfinder's busy, and the artificers are busier.
Not a thing. Ask me tomorrow.
